name: NEW ERA
description:
We’re excited for the return of Yanamaste to Oslo !
2yrs after we debuted him at our collaboration with Khidi.

In a new venue we’re looking forward to take over for this special night! With Mev & Koan playing before keep the floor hot and ready!, and a welcome to newer talent we have had our eyes on Plagsom b2b Tien Hoa to open the night!

Important reminder -
We'd like to remind you, that this event is a special occasion at a public venue. Please pay respect to the environment and the people at the event. We do not condone the use of any substances, And this is no place for discrimination, sexual harassment, racism, violence or homophobia. We want our guests to feel comfortable, regardless of gender, religion, class, or sexual orientation Take care of yourself and your body and help others who are in need If you are in an inappropriate situation or you observing one, please do not hesitate to talk to the our team or security at the event
